uncited: **Grid Storage:** The scene is represented by a 3D tensor (voxel grid) where each cell contains a feature vector.
**Sampling:** For a ray passing through the scene, sample points $\mathbf{x}$ are generated.

FastNeRF accelerates inference by factorizing the view-dependent radiance field into position-dependent and direction-dependent components, enabling efficient caching of intermediate network outputs [7183-fastnerf.md].

It solves the problem of high computational cost in standard NeRF by avoiding MLP evaluations at inference time, instead relying on hardware-accelerated ray tracing and grid lookups to achieve interactive frame rates (200Hz) on consumer hardware [7183-fastnerf.md].

It differs from its siblings, such as [C-NeRF](7275-c-nerf.md) and [V4D](8762-v4d-voxel-for-4d-novel-view-synthesis.md), by using a low-rank inner-product factorization to decouple spatial and directional information, whereas other methods may use spherical harmonics or explicit voxel grids for density only [7183-fastnerf.md].
VoxGRAF is a 3D-aware Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that replaces the coordinate-based Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) scene representation with a sparse voxel grid generator [12633-voxgraf.md].

It solves the problem of slow rendering and viewpoint/content entanglement inherent in previous 3D-aware GANs by enabling fast, 3D-consistent image synthesis with a single forward pass [12633-voxgraf.md].

Unlike its siblings [FastNeRF](7183-fastnerf.md), [C-NeRF](7275-c-nerf.md), [V4D](8762-v4d-voxel-for-4d-novel-view-synthesis.md), [RenderNet](10878-rendernet.md), and [Object-NeRF](11987-object-nerf.md) which often rely on dense coordinate-based queries or hybrid rendering, VoxGRAF generates the entire 3D radiance field on a sparse voxel grid using 3D convolutions, allowing for efficient rendering via alpha composition without reducing sample counts [12633-voxgraf.md].

Early works like [C-NeRF](7275-c-nerf.md) and [FastNeRF](7183-fastnerf.md) demonstrated that discretizing the scene into grids could significantly speed up training and inference. [V4D](8762-v4d-voxel-for-4d-novel-view-synthesis.md) extended this to 4D dynamic scenes, while [RenderNet](10878-rendernet.md) adapted voxel grids for differentiable rendering tasks like shape reconstruction.
